description:
Company Overview

We're scaling the best YouTube agency in the world.

We've assembled a crazy-talented group of YouTube strategists and creative minds who've collectively generated over 110 billion views and shaped how YouTube works today. Our founder, Ryan Hashemi, spent seven years building Jubilee Media into a 14-million-subscriber, 5-billion-view powerhouse with four Emmy nominations, and trained the person who now runs MrBeast's studio. Learn more about Ryan's journey here.

Now we're helping the world's biggest brands crack the code on YouTube and make content that people actually want to watch at scale.

How We Hire

We don't screen for pedigree or platform experience. We evaluate storytelling instinct, unique perspective, individual superpowers, and high agency. Our team includes SVP-level Condé Nast alumni working alongside self-taught YouTube strategists. We've got a flat culture and believe a good idea can come from anywhere.

The world's biggest brands know YouTube is the next frontier. They just need the right partner to help them win.

That's where you come in.

 

Your Role: Head of Casting

As Head of Casting, you’ll find the people who make our videos great and build the casting team that keeps finding them. You’ll cast hands-on, lead and mentor a team of freelance casting producers, and shape how casting works at Snowball, from the standards we hold to the talent network we grow. You’ll own the quality of every cast, keep shoots on schedule, and make sure every person who works with us has a great experience. One week you might be tracking down a world-class expert, and the next you’ll be filling a room with everyday people. Either way, you’ll know how to spot the ones with real insight and presence on camera.

You'll partner closely with production, creative, and client services, and you'll be consulted on topic selection so we can cast a wide net before an idea gets greenlit. You'll own casting timelines across multiple concurrent projects, flag risk early, and deploy deeply casting support as needed.

Over your first year, you'll build the playbook, training, and network that lets casting scale without depending on any single person, and as output grows, the role shifts further toward managing and growing the team.

 

What You'll Do

  • Cast hands-on on our highest-stakes and expert-led projects, from single specialists to volume casts of everyday people

  • Run casting interviews that surface authenticity, on-camera presence, and the specific insights each episode needs

  • Set a shared standard with directors and creative leads for what great cast looks like, and deliver multiple vetted options per role so we can choose the strongest fit every time

  • Manage, train, and give feedback to our freelance casting producers, holding every project to Snowball's bar

  • Build and launch Snowball's casting playbook and onboarding, including standards, outreach templates, and Snowball-owned outreach accounts that keep every outreach professional and consistent

  • Grow a Snowball-owned talent network across agencies, professional networks, and creators, capturing contacts and learnings from every episode so no project starts from zero

  • Own casting timelines across concurrent projects, keeping vetted backups ready for every shoot and flagging at-risk casts well before the shoot date

  • Vet talent carefully, including deeper background checks for sensitive clients, to protect our clients and our brand

  • Join ideation and topic selection early, and create cast clips that strengthen client pitches

  • Allocate freelancer time based on what's ahead or behind, and shape the recommendation for how our casting team should grow

 

What We're Looking For

We're looking for a casting leader who has:

  • 5+ years of casting experience, ideally as a casting producer or casting director in unscripted, reality, documentary, or digital-first content, casting both experts and everyday people

  • Sharp casting judgment: you know what makes someone compelling on camera, can explain why, and hold the bar when the easy option is whoever is available

  • A track record of casting wins you personally drove, with concrete examples of talent you found and why they worked

  • Experience running casting interviews that draw out authenticity, presence, and real insight

  • Established relationships with agencies, professional networks, and creators, and a reputation that brings talent back and earns referrals

  • Experience managing, training, or giving feedback to casting producers or freelancers, plus a low-ego willingness to do the work yourself

  • A systems-builder mindset: you create playbooks, templates, and organized contact databases others can follow

  • Strong organization and deadline ownership, with backups always ready and a calm, solution-oriented approach when talent falls through

  • Experience vetting talent and running background checks, including for sensitive or high-profile clients

  • A collaborative, coachable style: you work well across production, creative, and client teams, ask good questions, and welcome feedback

  • Hunger, resilience, and accountability, plus genuine excitement about building a function from the ground up

Bonus points if you have:

  • Experience building or leading a casting department at a digital media studio or YouTube channel

  • Experience with creator or short-form talent search

  • Experience teaching casting to others through training, workshops, or educational content

  • Familiarity with casting databases, CRMs, or tools for organizing talent at scale

 

What We Offer

  • Annual salary range: $140,000 to $160,000

  • Health & vision benefits

  • 401(k)

  • Remote flexible

  • Direct mentorship from the co-founders

  • Ground-floor opportunity at a fast-growing company

 

Our Values

  • Work hard, learn harder

  • Be effectively proactive

  • Overdeliver for clients

  • Be kind by being clear

  • A+ players only

 

Ready to Apply?

Resumes are great and all, but we'd love to see something creative that shows who you are and why you're excited about this role. We want to see the real you: what makes you unique, passionate, and ready to help us build the future of content marketing.
